网络存取(连结)层
网络存取(连结)层实际上并不是因特网协议组中的一部分，但是它是数据包从一个设备的网络层传输到另外一个设备的网络层的方法。这个过程能够在网卡的软件驱动程序中控制，也可以在韧体或者专用芯片中控制。这将完成如添加报头准备发送、通过實體媒介实际发送这样一些数据链路功能。另一端，链路层将完成数据帧接收、去除报头并且将接收到的包传到网络层。
然而，链路层并不经常这样简单。它也可能是一个虚拟专有网络（VPN）或者隧道，在这里从网络层来的包使用隧道协议和其他（或者同样的）协议组发送而不是发送到實體的接口上。VPN和通道通常预先建好，并且它们有一些直接发送到實體接口所没有的特殊特点（例如，它可以加密经过它的数据）。由于现在链路“层”是一个完整的网络，这种协议组的递归使用可能引起混淆。但是它是一个实现常见复杂功能的一个优秀方法。（尽管需要注意预防一个已经封装并且经隧道发送下去的数据包进行再次地封装和发送）。
items.final: Network access (connection) layer Network access (connection) layer is not actually part of the Internet protocol group, but it is the method by which data packages are transmitted from one device to another. This process can be controlled in the software driver of the network card, or in the body or in the dedicated chip. This will complete the function of adding the header to send, sending the data chain through the physical medium. On the other hand, the chain layer will complete the data frame reception, remove the header and transmit the received package to the network layer. However, the chain layer is not often so simple. It may also be a virtual proprietary network (VPN) or tunnel, where the package from the network layer uses the tunnel protocol and other (or the same) protocol group to send it to the interface rather than to the physical medium.

items.source_text: 自由电子气的费米面是一个球面；周期体系中的费米面则通常是扭曲面。费米面包围的体积决定了系统中的电子数，而费米面的拓扑结构则与金属的各种传导性质（如电导率）直接相关。对费米面的研究有时被称为“费米学”（Fermiology）。按电子运动维度可分为一维，二维和三维。二维电子气（two-dimensional electron gas， 2DEG）是指电子可以在二维方向自由移动，而在第三维上则受到限制的现象。在某些材料表面，电子密度很高，是一种平面电子集合，是一种二维液体。电子晶体（electride）：在离子性材料里存在周期性的空档，而电子正好落在这些空档里，充当了阴离子（anion）的角色。按照空档的维度来分类，有0维，1维和2维的电子晶体。这个维度指的是陷落电子势阱维度。电子晶体是一种双曲材料。一维和二维电子晶体材料从结构上就有严重的各向异性：电子在一个多两个方向不局域代表有很强的金属性，而在另外的方向金属性很弱，满足双曲材料最本质的要求。准三维电子晶体（quasi-three-dimensional electron crystal）：介于二维和三维之间的一种物质，将极纯净的半导体材料置入超低温环境下，并对其施加垂直和平行的强磁场中，半导体内的二维电子系统转变为准三维电子固体系统绝缘体。多级有序态（multipolar order）：晶体里的电子运动无序，在合适的情况下，晶体中的电荷会排列成重复的有序结构电荷有序态。电荷是一种标量，用数值或者量级可以描述这种物质形态。

items.source_text: 一些与Windows 9x同时期的操作系统（不管是多用户的或是拥有多个不同访问权限的用户户口）的重要系统文件（譬如内核映像）在大多数用户户口底下都是不可更动的。相反的，Windows 95及其后的操作系统为多个用户提供简档选项，它们没有访问权限的概念，使它们大致相当于单用户的、单户口的操作系统，意味着所有进程都可修改所有未打开的文件及引导扇区，或对硬盘进行修改。这使病毒及其它被秘密安装的软件更紧密地与操作系统结合在一起，使用户难以对它们进行侦查及撤消。在Windows 9x中的用户简档支持仅是为了方便而已。除非修改一些注册表项，在登录时可按下“取消”以访问系统，即使所有的简档都拥有口令保护。Windows 95的默认登录对话框允许在不登录的情况下创建新用户的简档。
items.final: Some important system files (e.g. kernel images) associated with Windows 9x (whether multi-user or multi-access user accounts) are not changeable under most user accounts. On the contrary, Windows 95 and its subsequent operating systems provide a simple profile option for multiple users, which do not have the concept of access, making them roughly equivalent to single-user, single-household operating systems, meaning that all processes can modify all unopened files and guide sectors, or modify hard disks. This makes viruses and other secretly installed software more closely integrated with operating systems, making it difficult for users to detect and withdraw them. User profiles in Windows 9x are supported only for ease.

items.source_text: 1905年，日本在旅顺口海战战胜沙俄，双方签署《朴次茅斯和约》，日俄战争结束。1905年11月17日，日本与大韩帝国签订《乙巳条约》，大韩帝国成为日本的保护国。1906年，日本在漢城（今首爾）设立“統監府”。伊藤博文成为日本在朝鲜半岛的第一任统监。为维护朝鲜半岛主权独立，1907年，高宗派3名特使到海牙和平会议，指控日本的侵略，呼吁各国的声援。但是在殖民主义盛行的20世纪初，日本对大韩帝国的保护国地位被认为是理所當然，因此高宗的特使没能挽救大韩帝国。日本以高宗派特使到海牙和平会议违反《乙巳条约》为由逼其让位给其子纯宗。与此同时，朝鲜半岛反日义兵运动高涨。1909年10月，韩国独立运动义兵参谋中将安重根在哈尔滨火车站将日本首任朝-{}-鲜统监伊藤博文击毙。
items.final: In 1905, Japan won the battle against Shaohai in the course of the trip, and the two sides signed the “Pukzhou and Yoo” Treaty, which ended the war between Japan and Russia. On 17 November 1905, Japan signed the “Bing Treaty” with the Great Korean Empire, which became Japan’s protectorate. In 1906, Japan established the “Supreme Office” in Seoul. Ito became Japan’s first governor on the Korean peninsula. In order to preserve the sovereignty and independence of the Korean peninsula, in 1907, the Korean Special Envoy to the Hague Peace Conference accused Japan of aggression and called for the support of the countries.

items.source_text: 同年，社會陸續出現業主加租迫遷租客事件，社會各界和政府亦開始關注此現象。羅旭龢和九龍居民協會均認為政府應及早制裁，羅旭龢甚至認為應組織一個維護居民權益的互助組織以向港府施壓，令港府施行有效之制裁法令。立法局、議政局均有討論此次事件。某位不願透露身份的富紳接受天光報訪問時表示，每月租金均定定在租約內，業主不能隨意加租，業主加租迫遷租客的行為只是為了中飽私囊。3月9日，史美接受記者訪問時表示政府已對此作出研究，並正與高官和華人領袖商討。由於準備工作過於倉促，因此此議題會否於定例局討論仍是未知之數，但若港督欲宣布對於此事對策，則應提出討論。港府委任史美、施戈斐侶和文烈（Robert John Minnitt）為調查委員會委員，負責研究加租迫遷事件前因後果，並為此提出解決方案。九龍居民協會亦收集住客情況，交至委員會以協助調查。6月1日，港府始推行《1938年制止加租逼遷條例》，作為緊急措施，條例有效期為1年。翌年，制止加租逼遷條例有效期延長至1940年。後來，史美接受非官守議員羅文錦的質問時，承認該法案中若干條款，特別是撤銷1938年限制逼遷條例內若干經已按揭的屋宇住客之保障，實與該法例所給予之保障相反，按揭人受該法例壓迫，但他認為不能為少數人知特別利益而修改該法例。

items.final: If you cannot find a list of the number of seconds between the two UTC moments, it is not possible to calculate the exact time difference for that period. Correspondingly, it is not possible to calculate the time difference for a time interval that ends with a future moment, because it may contain an indefinite number of seconds (e.g., how many TAI seconds are between “now” and “2099-12-31 23:59:59”). Thus, many scientific applications that require long-term (multi-year) high-precision measurements use TAI instead of UTC time. TAI is also often used in systems that cannot handle seconds. GPS is always 19 seconds behind TAI (TAI and GPS are not affected by the seconds introduced in UTC).

间歇性封锁国际出口
从2011年5月6日起，中国大陆境内很多互联网公司以及高校、学院、科研单位的对外网络连接都出现问题，包括中国科学院。有分析指断网可能是因为防火长城已经具有了探测和分析大量加密流量并对用户IP地址执行封锁的能力，而各大机构的出口被封也在其中。具体表现为：当用户使用了破网（翻墙）软件后，其所在的公共网络IP地址会被临时封锁，所有的国际网站都无法访问，包括MSN、iTunes Store等，而访问国内网站却正常，但如果使用境外的DNS解析域名则将会由于DNS服务器被封锁导致无法解析任何域名，国内网站也会无法打开。也有分析指，此举是中国当局在测试逐步切断大部分人访问国际网站的措施，以试探用户反应并最终达到推行网络「白名单」制，也就是凡没有在名单上的企业或团体其网络域名将不能解析，一般用户也无法访问。而中共党机关报《人民日报》旗下的《环球时报》英文版则引述方滨兴指，一些ISP必须为自己的用户支付国际流量费用，因此这些公司「有动机」去阻碍用户访问国外网站。一位不愿留名的工信部官员说，用户碰到这些情况应先检查自己和网站的技术问题。
items.final: Since 6 May 2011, many Internet companies in mainland China and external network connections to higher education, colleges, scientific research units, including the Chinese Academy of Sciences, have been experiencing problems. There are analyses that the network may have been cut off because the Great Wall of Fire has the ability to detect and analyse large amounts of encrypted traffic and to block user IP addresses, and that the exports of major institutions have been blocked. Specifically, when users use broken network (reversing) software, their public network IP addresses are temporarily blocked, all international websites are inaccessible, including MSN, iTunes Store, etc., while access to domestic websites is normal, but if the DNS domain name is used outside the country, the DNS server will be blocked, and the domestic website will not be able to open.

items.source_text: 相反的例子是非自由软件（封闭软件）。如果，當使用者付费購買或者免费获得某套軟體時，所得到的只是“使用權”，使用者必須接受該軟體的软件许可证才能使用這個軟體；而许可证列明軟體的原作者則仍然保有修改权，未经原作者同意进行修改属违反许可证之行为，则该等软件属于封闭软件。请注意，自由软件也有许可证，常见的如GNU通用公共许可证，但这些许可证不会限制你获取原始码或者限制你修改软件，唯一的要求是你对修改后的软件必须应用同样的或更宽松的许可证。即你修改后形成的新软件，其他人也可以获取其原始码并修改，你不得限制他们这样做，否则你当初的修改行为就因不符合GNU通用公共许可证而构成侵犯（之前参与编写这个软件的人所享有的）著作权。
items.final: The opposite example is non-free software (closed software). If, when a user pays for or obtains a set of software free of charge, the user receives only “use rights” and the user must accept the software's software licence in order to use the software; and the original author of the software listed in the licence retains the right to modify it without the consent of the original author, and the modification is contrary to the licence, the software is closed software. Note that free software also has a licence, commonly known as the GNU General Public Licence, but these licences do not limit your access to the original code or limit your modification of the software, the only requirement being that you apply the same or more liberal licence to the modified software. That is, the new software that you modify, others can also access the original code and modify it, and you cannot limit them to do so, otherwise your original modification would constitute an infringement of the GNU General Public Licence (the rights that the person who previously participated in the preparation of the software enjoyed).

items.source_text: 印度并不是单一民族及文化的国家，其境內民族和种族繁多，印度人中的印度斯坦族占印度总人口的大约一半，各族群都拥有各自的语言文字，仅宪法承认的官方语言就有22种之多，其中印地语和英语均被定为联邦官方的语言，并且法院裁定印度没有国语；英语作為共同語言使用在印度非常流行，尤其是在南印度，地位更高于印地语。印度也是一个多宗教多信仰的国家，号称“宗教博物馆”，世界主要宗教中的佛教和印度教都源自古印度，而大部分印度人信仰印度教；伊斯兰教作为印度的第二大宗教也有1亿8千万信徒，自公元8世纪随着阿拉伯帝国的扩张而传播到印度次大陆，公元10世纪后北印度的大多数王朝统治者都信奉伊斯兰教，其中的莫卧儿王朝几乎征服整个次大陆。印度是公认拥有核武器的国家之一。印度也是众多正式和非正式的多边国际组织的成员，包括聯合國、世界贸易组织、大英國協、金砖五国、四國聯盟、南亚区域合作联盟和不结盟运动等。印度被视为潜在超级大国之一。印度是世界第三大军费支出国，在2021年其军费预算达到766亿美元。
items.final: India is not a single ethnic and cultural country, with a large number of ethnic and racial groups, with the Indian population of the Indian population accounting for about half of the total population of India, with each ethnic group having its own language and language, with more than 22 official languages recognized only by the Constitution, including Hindi and English, which are recognized as the official language of the Federation, and the Court has ruled that India has no national language; English is used as a common language in India, especially in South India, which is higher than Hindi. India is also a multi-religious country, known as the “Religious Museum”, and Buddhism and Hinduism in the world’s major religions are derived from ancient India, while most Indians believe in Hinduism; Islam, as the second largest religion in India, has 180 million followers, spread to the Indian subcontinent with the expansion of the Arab Empire in the eighth century, and most of the rulers of North India after the tenth century have been Muslim, with the Mawar dynasty almost conquering the entire subcontinent.

中華民國外交部在2004年執行一個外交專案，代號「安亞專案」。主要內容為避免中華民國在世界貿易組織的名稱遭矮化，從事機密外交，行賄收買世界貿易組織前秘書長泰國籍的與相關人士，至少花費60萬美金（約新台幣5000萬）以上。為安亞專案所需，2005年1月間，邱義仁以「國家安全會議秘書長函」，發文指示外交部將50萬美元匯入國安會指定帳戶。外交部次長高英茂以越洋電話指示外交部人員以旅行支票將款項匯出，由國安會副秘書長柯承亨在美國領取，交付相關人士。
items.final: In January 2005, in order to avoid the diminution of the name of the Chinese People’s Republic of China in the World Trade Organization, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs carried out a diplomatic project, code-named the “Anya Project.” The main content was to avoid the diminution of the name of the Chinese People’s Republic of China in the World Trade Organization, to carry out secret diplomacy, to buy the former Secretary-General of the World Trade Organization, the Thai national and his associates, at least $600,000 (approximately $50 million in new Taiwan dollars). In order to meet the needs of the Anya Project, in January 2005, Qiu Yi-in, in a letter from the Secretary-General of the National Security Council, instructed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to transfer $500,000 to the designated account of the National Security Council.

《人民报》（越南语：）是越南共产党中央委员会机关报，该报的宗旨是传递越南“党、国家和人民的声音”。1951年3月11日，《人民报》在反抗法国殖民主义的战争中创刊，继承了胡志明创刊的《青年报》的传统。旗下刊物
《人民报》日报发行量22万份，16版面的周末报每周11万份；48版面的《人民月刊》发行量每期13万份；24版面的《今日报》逢周一、四发行，发行量5万份。第一份互联网版的《人民报》于1998年6月21日创立，有越、法双语，是越南首家互联网日报。

1949年1月20日美国总统哈利·S·杜鲁门在其就职典礼的讲话中上宣布对“发展中国家”进行技术援助的的“第四点计划”（Point Four Program），并因为本计划是该次讲话中所提及的第四点外交政策目标，所以得名“第四点计划”。其目标是将美国的援助范围扩充到发展中国家，实质是加强对外经济扩张，遏制共产主义，控制不发达国家的受援国，同时为美国赢得对中东地区的石油控制权，获得巨大的经济利益。
这是美国外交战略上最具里程碑意义的一次。
items.final: On 20 January 1949, US President Harry S. Truman announced in his inaugural address the “Fourth Point Program” for technical assistance to “developing countries” and, because the plan was the fourth foreign policy objective mentioned in the speech, it was known as the “Fourth Point Program.” Its objective was to expand US assistance to developing countries, essentially to strengthen foreign economic expansion, curb communism, control the recipient countries of the less developed countries, and win the United States oil control over the Middle East region and gain significant economic benefits.

items.source_text: 語句Python的语句包括简单语句：赋值语句，记号为等号=。赋值语句被用来将名字绑定（含重新绑定）到值，以及用来修改可变对象的特性或项目。Python还支持增广赋值语句，将一个二元运算和一个赋值语句合并成一个单一语句，例如x += 1。Python支持“序列解包”（sequence unpacking）：在等号左侧可以是一个表达式列表，其中每个表示式都可求值成能被赋值的东西（变量、可写特性等）；在等号右侧相应的是一个“可迭代”对象，它在被迭代时产生的值的数量，同于左手侧可写表达式的数量；赋值语句对这个对象进行迭代，将产生的每个值分别赋值给左侧对应的可赋值者。在等号右侧直接包装出序列解包所要求的元组，就形成了并行赋值，可以同时给多个变量赋值，还可以交换两个变量的值。语句，用来交互式的计算并写出一个值，或者用来调用一个过程（即返回无含义结果的函数），在Python中过程返回值None。global语句，是在整个当前代码块中成立的声明，它意味着随后列出的标识符被解释为全局变量。nonlocal语句，导致随后列出的标识符，提及在除了全局作用域之外的最近包围作用域中的先前绑定变量。type语句，介入于版本3.12，声明作为类型别名类型（typing.TypeAliasType）的实例的一个类型别名。pass語句，充当NOP，表示此行為空，不執行任何操作。assert語句，用於程式調適階段時測試執行條件是否滿足。continue语句，越过这次迭代并继续进行下个项目。break语句，从循环中跳出。
items.final: The Python statement includes simple statements: assignment statements, symbols =. The assignment statement is used to bind the name to the value (including re-binding) and to modify the characteristics or items of the variable object. Python also supports the extension of the assignment statement, which combines a binary operation and a assignment statement into a single statement, such as x += 1. Python supports the “sequence unpacking” (sequence unpacking): on the left side of the equal sign, it can be a list of expressions, each of which can be expressed as a value (variable, writeable, etc.); on the right side of the equal sign, it is a “repetitive” object, which is the number of values generated when it is repeated, the number of values that can be written on the left side of the expression; the assignment statement is used to assign the value to the left side of the expression, and the value is used to assign the value to the left side of the expression.

items.source_text: 定义讨论“吸血驴”，并不是狭义地仅指其只下载资源数据不上传，或上传下载比例很小。一般来说，有任何不良行为、有损其他客户端或服务器的eD2k软件、不利于eD2k网络公平性的行为都可称为“吸血驴”。这些不良行为通常可能包括：只下载不上传或上传下载比例很小；只上传自己可以交换到对方下载的最小数据量。即Credit Shaping，相当于用软件实现“下了就跑”；每次启动时或正常工作时变换自己的UserHash（用戶哈希值）和安全认证，让其他客户端误认为此客户端是新手；假冒不同的IP+端口下同一个文件；过于频繁地向其他客户端或服务器端发送请求，称攻击性客户端；使用虚假的ModString，或盗用其他客户端的ModString或者用户名、UserHash等（有可能能躲过某些客户端反吸血功能的侦测。盗用用户名则向连接客户显示与该客户一模一样的用户名，这可以从社区加分客户端获得上传加分）；故意传播坏文件段或是假冒成熱門檔案，骗取上传；伪造队列排名，严重影响公平；滥用社区加分。社区加分就是某客户端软件为自己的软件用户或某些特定人群加分，其他客户端将受到歧视，有损公平性。其吸血的程度可视社区加分的程度而定，有时称社区吸血，这个软件使用者所构成的网络也被称为私有网络；不能主动生成eD2k链接，只能被动地接收eD2k链接。有用户认为这是“消极共享”的行为，不利于网络公平性。
items.final: The definition of “blood-sucking donkeys” is not narrowly limited to the fact that it only downloads resource data and does not upload, or that the download ratio is very small. Generally, any bad behaviour, eD2k software that damages other clients or servers, or behaviour that is not conducive to the fairness of the eD2k network, can be called “blood-sucking donkeys.” These bad behaviour may usually include: downloading only a small amount of data that can be exchanged between the other client or server; uploading only the minimum amount of data that can be downloaded by the other client or server. That is, Credit Shaping, which is equivalent to the use of software to “run down” the other client or server; changing the UserHash (user hash) and security authentication at each start-up or normal work time, so that other clients may be mistaken as new clients; using the same file under different IP+ ports; sending requests to other clients or servers too frequently, claiming that the client is aggressive; using false ModString, or using the other client's ModString or user name, UserHash, etc.

items.final: Rick Mascitti was asked in 1992 in an informal way, and he said that it was said in a half-joking way. He never thought that C++ would be the official name of the language. There was a joke about the C++ name, which was that when you used the post++, the addition only happened after the calculation (so it should be ++C, not C++, which is a joke that some programmers are still using C++ in the way that C is used, which is often considered incorrect by some authoritative writings).

items.final: Economists generally agree that the CFA franc will eventually be abandoned by the member countries of the franc zone, at least its operating mechanisms will be significantly changed. Economists have designed four alternative options for the CFA franc: (i) negotiating monetary cooperation with the European Union to link the CFA franc to the European Central Bank rather than to the French Treasury; (ii) the West African Economic and Monetary Union and the Central African Economic and Monetary Community creating a common currency, linked to the same basket of currencies (e.g. the United States dollar, the euro, the renminbi); (iii) the West African Economic and Monetary Union and other member countries of the Economic Community of West African States creating a common currency zone; and (iv) gradually establishing a unified monetary zone for Africa.

items.source_text: 实现跨平台性的方法是大多数编译器在进行Java语言程序的编码时候会生成一个用字节码写成的“半成品”，这个“半成品”会在Java虚拟机（解释层）的帮助下运行，虚拟机会把它转换成当前所处硬件平台的原始代码。之后，Java虚拟机会打开标准库，进行数据（图片、线程和网络）的存取工作。主要注意的是，尽管已经存在一个进行代码翻译的解释层，有些时候Java的字节码代码还是会被JIT编译器进行二次编译。
items.final: The method of achieving cross-platform is that most compilers generate a “semi-finished” in byte code when they are coding the Java language program, which is run with the help of the Java virtual machine (the interpretation layer) and which converts it into the original code of the current hardware platform. Then, the Java virtual machine opens the standard library to access data (images, threads and networks).

items.source_text: 李东生（2001年－2009年10月）代表中共中央宣传部任中央610办公室副主任，历任CCTV副台长，中宣部副部长（主管法轮功事务），是中宣部长刘云山的主要助手，对中国大陆1999年至2002年四年间主要媒体包括CCTV进行的反法轮功宣传负主要责任。李东生曾以中国代表团特别顾问身份在联合国人权委员会第57届会议上接受记者采访，并就妇女问题作专题发言攻击诬蔑法轮功。李东生以610办公室副主任身份随领导小组组长李岚清到各地视察。李东生已于2013年12月被移送法办，2016年1月12日获刑15年。王晓翔：最迟于2003年1月任中央610公室副主任。曾任中央政府机关党工委办公室主任、中央国家机关青联主席（1999年10月）。王晓翔曾出席北京市“与法轮功斗争工作会议”并发言，还以中国代表团特别顾问身份在联合国人权委员会第58届会议上发言，对法轮功及其创始人进行攻击并为江泽民的镇压辩护。袁隐：2001年任中央610办公室副主任，原国务院办公厅秘书四局副局长（1997至1998），国务院办公厅秘书三局局长（1999至2000）。高以忱：曾任中央610办公室副主任，时任国家安全部副部长。徐海斌：曾任中央610办公室副主任，时任中央政法委秘书，后任中央政法委副部级领导、第十三届全国政协委员。孙力军（2013年－2018年3月）任中央610办公室副主任，同时担任公安部国保局（一局）局长兼二十六局（公安部610办公室）局长，镇压法轮功，并抓捕709律师。

items.source_text: 轨道器包含火箭和飞行器双重设计元素，既能像火箭般垂直发射，又能像滑翔机一样着陆。机身分成三部分，为乘员舱、货舱、发动机舱和飞行操纵提供支持。航天飞机主发动机舱在轨道器后部，发射时提供推力，还有轨道机动系统确保轨道器能在太空进入、更换和退出轨道。两侧的三角翼长18米，内边缘（机翼后侧）与机身呈81°角，外缘（机翼前侧）呈45°。两翼内外都有升降副翼，航天飞机再入时能与两翼之间位于发动机下方、用来控制横轴的襟翼一起提供飞行控制功能。轨道器的垂尾后仰45°，上面的方向舵能拆分开来起减速作用。垂尾还包含两部分减速伞系统，能在轨道器着陆后减速。轨道器采用伸缩式起落架，由前起落架和两个主起落架组成，每个都有两个轮胎，前起落架还有电动液压转向功能。
items.final: The orbital vehicle contains a dual design element of rockets and aircraft, which can be launched vertically like rockets and landed like gliders. The body is divided into three parts, supporting the crew, cargo, engine and flight control. The main engine of the space shuttle is located in the rear of the orbital vehicle, providing thrust at the time of launch, and the orbital motor system ensures that the orbital vehicle can enter, replace and exit the orbit. The two wings are 18 metres long, the inner edge (the back of the wing) is 81° from the body, and the outer edge (the front of the wing) is 45°. There are two subwings inside and outside the wing, and the space shuttle re-entry is able to provide flight control functions with the two wings, which are located below the engine, and the two wings, which are used to control the transverse axis. The orbital vehicle is 45° from the rear of the orbital vehicle, and the two wings are separated from the orbital vehicle.

items.source_text: 第一部電腦並沒有作業系統。這是由於早期電腦的建立方式（如同建造機械算盤）與效能不足以執行如此程式。但在1947年發明了電晶體，以及莫里斯·威尔克斯發明的微程序方法，使得電腦不再是機械裝置，而是電子產品。系統管理工具以及簡化硬體操作流程的程式很快就出現了，且成為作業系統的起源。到了1960年代早期，商用電腦製造商製造了批次處理系統，此系統可將工作的建置、排程以及執行序列化。此時，廠商為每一台不同型號的電腦創造不同的作業系統，因此為某電腦而寫的程式無法移植到其他電腦上執行，即使是同型號的電腦也不行。
items.final: The first computer did not have an operating system. This was due to the way early computers were built (as if they were built to calculate machines) and were not efficient enough to run such programs. But in 1947, electrical crystals were invented, and Maurice Wilks invented a micro-programming method that made computers no longer mechanical devices, but electronic products. System management tools and programs that simplified hardware operations quickly appeared and became the source of the operating system. By the early 1960s, commercial computer manufacturers had created batch processing systems that could build, schedule and sequence their work.

items.source_text: 文化路徑的概念在1993年聖雅各之路列入世界遺產後，1994年11月在馬德里舉行的専家會議上首度提出；1998年ICOMOS成立「文化路徑國際委員會」（CIIC）；CIIC在2005年完成文化路徑內容細則；ICOMOS在2008年公布《文化路徑憲章》，揭示文化路徑整體構想、管理與保護機制。文化路徑反映當代文化資產保存的整合思維，遺產保護不只是單純的修復與保存，還涉及環境教育、博物館詮釋、產業振興、觀光發展、文化認同、人才培育等面向，而成為一個整合性的地方發展戰略。
items.final: The concept of cultural pathways was first introduced at the ICOMOS International Committee on Cultural Pathways (CIIC) in Madrid in November 1994, after the inclusion of the St. James Road in the World Heritage in 1993; ICOMOS established the CIIC in 1998; CIIC completed the details of the cultural pathways in 2005; ICOMOS published the Charter of Cultural Pathways in 2008, revealing the whole idea of cultural pathways, management and protection mechanisms. The cultural pathways reflect the integration of cultural assets preservation in the contemporary era, and the protection of heritage is not only a simple restoration and preservation, but also involves environmental education, museum interpretation, industrial revitalization, tourism development, cultural recognition, talent development, etc., and becomes a comprehensive local development strategy.

items.source_text: 爱尔兰内战（；；1922年6月28日－1923年5月24日），是一场1921年12月6日签署的建立了爱尔兰自由邦（今天的爱尔兰共和国的前身）的英爱条约的支持者与反对者之间的冲突。条约的反对者反对保留英国与爱尔兰之间的宪政联系和北爱尔兰六郡未被包括于自由邦之内。内战伤亡远大于之前的爱尔兰独立战争之伤亡，并在爱尔兰社会留下深刻裂痕，它对今日爱尔兰政治的影响仍显而易见。
items.final: The Irish civil war (; 28 June 1922-24 May 1923) was a conflict between supporters and opponents of the British Treaty of Love, signed on 6 December 1921, which established the Irish Commonwealth (the predecessor of the Irish Republic today). The Treaty’s opponents opposed the retention of constitutional ties between the United Kingdom and Ireland and the exclusion of the six counties of Northern Ireland from the Commonwealth. The civil war was much more deadly than the previous Irish war of independence, leaving deep divisions in Irish society, and its impact on Irish politics today is still evident.

锂的来源也包括天然卤水和某些盐湖水。加工过程是将锂沉淀成Li2NaPO4，再将其转变为碳酸锂，即可作为原料来加工其他锂化合物了。加工天然卤水还可得到硼砂、碳酸钾、氯化钠、硫酸钠和氯化镁等。金属锂的制备电解法锂可由电解熔融氯化锂而得。Guntz首先建议用电解熔融氯化锂和氯化钾的混合物来制备金属锂，这样可以把熔融温度从单质锂的610℃降至400℃。以石墨为阳极，以低碳钢为阴极，电解槽压为6.0－6.5V。这样可以得到纯度达到99%的锂。
items.final: The extraction of natural halogen water also includes natural halogen water and certain salt lake water. The processing process is to convert lithium into Li2NaPO4 and then into lithium carbonate, which can be used as a raw material for other lithium compounds. The processing of natural halogen water can also be obtained with boron, potassium carbonate, sodium chloride, sodium sulfate and magnesium chloride. The preparation of lithium by electrolysis can be obtained by electrolytic melting of lithium chloride. Guntz first suggests the preparation of lithium metal by a mixture of electrolytic melting of lithium chloride and potassium chloride, which can reduce the melting temperature from 610°C to 400°C.

items.source_text: 然而多项式的指数很大的时候，算法在实践中也不能看作是有效的。如的多项式算法，取问题规模大小为1000，那么几乎就是的大小。另一方面，即便一个问题没有多项式算法，它可能会有近似比很好的近似算法（参见近似算法），或有很好的启发式算法（heuristics）。启发式算法的特点是在理论上没有精确的行为的分析，或者可以表明存在很坏的输入，在这些输入上运行很慢。然而在大多数时候，它都能快速解决问题。计算复杂性中对应的理论分析是平均复杂性理论（average-case complexity theory）和光滑分析（smooth analysis）。实际中的例子包括、布尔可满足性问题（参见SAT solver）和背包问题。
items.final: However, when multiple indices are very large, algorithms cannot be considered effective in practice. For example, multiple algorithms, with a problem size of 1,000, are almost the size. On the other hand, even if a problem does not have multiple algorithms, it may have a near approximation of a good approximation (see approximation algorithms) or a good heuristic algorithm (heuristics). The heuristic algorithm is characterized by an analysis of behaviour that is not precise in theory, or by the fact that there is a bad input that operates slowly. However, in most cases, it solves the problem quickly. The theoretical analysis that corresponds to the complexity of the calculation is the average complexity theory (average-case complexity theory) and smooth analysis (smooth analysis).

items.final: In economics, it is a price change indicator that reflects the prices of products and services related to the lives of residents, expressed in percentage changes. It is one of the main indicators of inflation. More than 3% is defined as inflation, and more than 5% is a more serious inflation. CPI is often an important reference for economic activity and government monetary policy. CPI stability, full employment, and GDP growth are often the most important social and economic objectives.

items.source_text: 套利交易使不同货币向其购买力平价回归。例如假设大豆能在中美两国间自由交易，且美国大豆价格除去运输成本及关税仍低于中国大豆价格。中国商人将进口美国大豆在本国销售套利，而美国商人也会购买美国大豆并运往中国销售。中国商人需要兑换美元以购买美国大豆，而美国商人需要卖出其在中国销售大豆换取的人民币。两国商人都将增加美元的需求和人民币的供给，这导致美元相对人民币升值，并使以美元标价的美国大豆价格走高，而中国大豆价格走低，直到套利机会消失。类似的针对全球各种商品、货币及其金融衍生品的套利交易使得各种货币的汇率与其购买力平价趋向一致。
items.final: Arbitrage transactions bring different currencies back to their purchasing power parity. For example, it is assumed that soybeans can be traded freely between the two countries, and that US soybean prices, minus transport costs and tariffs, are still lower than Chinese soybean prices. Chinese businessmen will import US soybeans for sale in their own country, while US businessmen will buy US soybeans and sell them to China. Chinese businessmen will need to convert US dollars to buy US soybeans, while US businessmen will need to sell the renminbi in exchange for soybeans sold in China.

items.final: On 3 June 2008, the Bank of Commerce and Industry acquired 53.12% of the shares held by the Yonglong Bank, headed by the Wu Yisun family, at a price of HK$ 19.3 billion (approximately RMB 17.2 billion) in cash, or HK$ 156.5 per share, and acquired the remaining shares in 2009, fully controlling the Bank of Yonglong, making it a fully-owned subsidiary. items.source_text: 行印（BANK SEAL）。由联邦储备银行印制的美元上除了库印外还有不同联邦银行的行印，其它券种则没有。行印表示发行该券的银行，行印是黑色圆形，直径为16毫米，外围有三十个齿。圆内有两圈文字外圈为联邦储备银行名称，内圈为城市名。行印的中心是银行的代号字母（该字母与连号首位的字母相同）。1934年版和以前各版，是大行印，外围无齿，直径为19毫米。1950年版和以后各版是小行印，直径为16毫米。
items.final: In addition to the bank's imprint, there are different federal bank imprints on the United States dollar printed by the Federal Reserve Bank, and there are no other coupons. The bank that issues the coupon is black, with a diameter of 16 mm and 30 teeth on the outside. The inner circle is the name of the Federal Reserve Bank, and the inner circle is the name of the city. The centre of the imprint is the bank's code letter (the same as the first letter of the serial number). The 1934 edition and the previous editions are large, with no teeth on the outside, with a diameter of 19 mm. The 1950 edition and subsequent editions are small, with a diameter of 16 mm.

一些知识体系或方法论不能纳入现代科学体系，例如中医学。但在中国，中医受到官方扶持，大多数民众也都会在某些时候采用与中医相关的疗法。这与世界其它某些地区的情形类似，如印度的传统医术阿育吠陀也受到官方扶持及民间的普遍相信。目前对中医的主要研究是用对比实验确切地检验中医疗法中有哪些能有效医治病人。2013年，史蒂文·诺维拉(Steven Novella)和曾撰文指出有关针灸的现有论文出现了一个奇怪的现象，即有些人的实验结果表明针灸有疗效，而另一些人所做的实验则无显著效果。因此两人推测针灸实验可能出现假阳性结果。而对于假阳性结果为何比较多，两人则猜测是安慰剂效应在起作用。
items.final: Science and ancient traditional medicine Some knowledge systems or methodological approaches cannot be incorporated into modern scientific systems, such as Chinese medicine. But in China, Chinese medicine is officially supported, and most people will use Chinese-related therapies at some point. This is similar to other parts of the world, such as the traditional medicine of India, which is also officially supported and widely believed by the public.

items.source_text: Lisa是一款具有划时代意义的电脑，在Mac的开发早期，很多系统软件都是在Lisa上设计的。它具有16位元的CPU、鼠标、硬盘，以及支持图形用户界面和多任务的操作系统，并且随机捆绑了7个商用软件。Lisa在1983年1月以9,995美元的身价初次露面。苹果再次推出了一款超越它所处时代的产品，但过于昂贵的价格和缺少软件开发商的支持，使苹果再次失去获得企业市场份额的机会。Lisa在1986年被终止，余货被埋在犹他州的垃圾堆填区。
items.final: Lisa is a landmark computer, and many of the system software was designed on Lisa in the early stages of Mac’s development. It has 16-bit CPUs, mouse, hard disk, and supports graphical user interfaces and multitask operating systems, and randomly binds seven commercial software. Lisa appeared for the first time in January 1983 at a price of $9,995. Apple has again launched a product that goes beyond its time, but the high cost and lack of support from software developers have once again deprived apples of the opportunity to gain access to the business market. Lisa was terminated in 1986 and the rest was buried in Utah’s landfill area.

items.source_text: 1967年5月，以色列与邻国的紧张关系再度升级。埃及驱逐驻扎在加沙地带的联合国维持和平部队，宣布战略要地堤蓝海峡向以色列船只关闭，以色列认为这是不宣而战，于是在6月5日向埃及发动攻擊。六日战争中，以色列憑藉北約及美國政府的支持，击败蘇聯支持下的阿拉伯国家，并且摧毁他们的空军力量。以色列完全佔領约旦河西岸、加沙地带、西奈半岛和戈兰高地。1949年的绿线被藐視成以色列在占领领土上的行政边界。尽管以色列占领区存在主权争议，以色列還是違反國際法與聯合國決議佔據东耶路撒冷和戈兰高地。《以埃和平条约》签字后，西奈半岛归还埃及。
items.final: In May 1967, tensions between Israel and its neighbours escalated again. Egypt expelled the United Nations peacekeeping forces in the Gaza Strip, declaring the strategic Blue Channel closed to Israeli ships, which Israel considered to be an undeclared war, and launched an attack on Egypt on 5 June. In the six-day war, Israel, with the support of the North and the United States government, defeated the Arab countries supported by the Soviet Union and destroyed their air force. Israel completely occupied the West Bank, the Gaza Strip, the Sinai Peninsula and the Golan Heights. The 1949 Green Line was ignored as Israel’s administrative border in the occupied territories.
